SID/STAR procedures in AD-2 aerodrome sections. No standalone AIXM export found.

countries.aip_authority: CARC (Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission of Jordan)
countries.notes: CARC publishes individual SID/STAR/IAP charts as PDF files directly on carc.gov.jo (open, no login). PDFs are Adobe Illustrator-generated vector charts (confirmed one file: metadata shows AI origin, Oct 2025). However, chart content is rasterized/compressed in a way that makes text extraction unreliable (tested STAR PDF returned as binary image stream). Procedures are published as individual chart PDFs rather than a structured eAIP HTML. Amendments quarterly plus AIRAC. No AIXM or coded database export. Also listed in EAD.

countries.aip_authority: DPRK Civil Aviation Administration (CAA) – Flight Operation Department
countries.notes: No publicly accessible official AIP. DPRK CAA provided an AIP copy to FAA historically but there is no open digital portal. The only available reference is an unofficial GitHub repository (ZKKP-AIP) containing community-recreated charts as Google Drawings, not official data. US/UN sanctions add legal friction. ICAO has identified differences from standards. FAA prohibits US operator flights in ZKKP FIR. Effectively inaccessible for programmatic parsing.

countries.aip_authority: Rwanda Civil Aviation Authority (RCAA) / Rwanda Airports Company (RAC)
countries.notes: eAIP Rwanda published openly via ASECNA AIM portal (aim.asecna.aero/eAIP_Rwanda) and RAC mirror (rac.co.rw/eAIP Rwanda). HTML eAIP structure present (ICAO-standard sections GEN/ENR/AD) but procedure content for HRYR/HRYI/HRYN is delivered as linked PDF charts only – no procedure tables in HTML. SID/STAR/IAP charts are vector PDFs (text-selectable). No login required. Updated on AIRAC cycle (~28 days). +1 for per-chart PDF navigation needed to extract procedure data.

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA
countries.notes: Togo is an ASECNA member state; AIP at aim.asecna.aero. AD-2.DXXX section for Lome/Gnassingbe Eyadema confirmed accessible without login — bilingual HTML tables with aerodrome data valid from APR 2026. SID/STAR/IAP procedure details are in PDF charts under /cartes/atlas/togo/Lome/ (IAC-VOR22, ILC, VLC confirmed). AIXM 4.5 backend per ICAO. Same structure as Benin: open eAIP HTML for aerodrome facts, vector PDF charts for procedures. Score 7: same friction as BJ.

countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC France (CAR-SAM-NAM region)
countries.notes: Guadeloupe (TFFR) is covered by SIA France under the CAR-SAM-NAM eAIP, freely accessible without login. HTML aerodrome sections reference procedure data but SID/STAR charts are embedded PDF links. Structure mirrors metropolitan France SIA eAIP — parseable but irregular. URL pattern: sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_[DATE]/CAR-SAM-NAM/...

countries.aip_authority: OFNAC (Office Nationale d'Aviation Civile)
countries.notes: OFNAC publishes the Haiti AIP as PDF amendments on ofnac.gouv.ht (latest known: AMDT 0120, Apr 2023). AIP appears to be open-access PDF (no registration found). PDFs appear to be text-generated (not scanned), but OFNAC website is intermittently down (503 errors observed). Update cadence irregular; site reliability is poor. Score raised for portal instability and uncertain currency.

countries.aip_authority: Jamaica Civil Aviation Authority (JCAA)
countries.notes: JCAA operates a subscription-based E-PUBs portal (aim.jcaa.aero) for AIP access; PDF charts for SIDs/STARs. Backend is AIXM-compliant database but no open AIXM export. Procedures for MKJP/MKJS available only via paid/agreement subscription. No open eAIP HTML confirmed.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS)
countries.notes: CAAS publishes a full eAIP via aim-sg.caas.gov.sg with no login required. AD-2 sections (e.g. SG-AD-2-WSSS) are HTML pages containing SID/STAR waypoint coordinate tables (WGS84 text), altitude/speed constraints, and procedure route descriptions in structured HTML. Charts also available as PDF (vector). Updated every AIRAC cycle (28 days). No AIXM export confirmed but eAIP HTML is clean and machine-parseable. Singapore is a major hub with a modern, well-maintained AIS.

countries.aip_authority: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) – Syria
countries.notes: GACA Syria website under maintenance as of June 2026. No publicly accessible eAIP or digital AIP portal found. Last known official AIP document is a 2016-era scanned PDF (CCITT Fax compression, non-selectable text, produced on Konica Minolta copier). Damascus International Airport (OSDI) resumed civil operations January 2025 after conflict, but GACA is rebuilding infrastructure with ICAO support. February 2025 ICAO agreement for air navigation modernisation signed. Significant sanctions/conflict friction. Scoring 9 reflects restricted access and absence of functioning public AIP portal; confidence low due to rapidly changing post-conflict situation.

countries.aip_authority: Tonga Civil Aviation Division (Ministry of Infrastructure) / Aeropath NZ (publisher)
countries.notes: AIP produced under Tonga Ministry of Infrastructure Civil Aviation Division authority; distributed by Aeropath NZ as PDF-only. Free download ($0 NZD) but checkout/account registration required. No eAIP HTML or coded data. Charts are vector PDF. +1 for portal friction.

countries.aip_authority: State Civil Aviation Department Turkmenhowayollary (AIS/Ashgabat International Airport)
countries.notes: AIP published by Russia's CAICA on behalf of Turkmenistan (Turkmenhowayollary). HTML navigation wrapper but all procedure documents are PDF. PDFs confirmed text-based (Tj/TJ ops, no CCITTFaxDecode). Portal hosted on caica.ru; updated per AIRAC cycle (56- or 28-day). No AIXM. Direct link to procedures requires navigating the portal index. +1 for clunky third-party Russian portal and indirect hosting.

countries.aip_authority: Belize Department of Civil Aviation (BDCA)
countries.notes: Belize eAIP is hosted on COCESNA's Eurocontrol-platform (cocesna.org/aipca/AIPMZ/) in HTML format, open access without login. Procedure tables are sparse; SID/STAR detail is in linked PDF charts (rasterized or image-based), not in structured HTML. ENR sections provide text rules only. Navigation portal adds friction (+1).

countries.aip_authority: Department of Air Transport (DOAT), Royal Government of Bhutan
countries.notes: DOAT publishes eAIP and AIP amendments as text-based PDFs (confirmed: Tj/TJ text operators, DCTDecode images for charts, no CCITTFax scan encoding). Main portal at doat.gov.bt/aip returns 403; amendment PDFs directly accessible at doat.gov.bt/aipp. AIS page states AIP available on 'hard and soft copy on sale or exchange, subscription form required'. Only VQPR (Paro) in scope — has RNP AR procedures, no conventional SIDs. +1 for portal friction and subscription requirement.

countries.aip_authority: DCAC / Department of Civil Aviation Cyprus
countries.notes: Cyprus DCAC AIS publishes EUROCONTROL-format eAIP HTML; own portal at airac.dca.mcw.gov.cy requires account/registration. Also accessible via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration). ECAC state, AIRAC-cycle updates confirmed through 2026. No direct AIXM export found. EAD Basic provides AIXM 5.1 for ECAC states including LC. Procedures as eAIP HTML + PDF charts; account friction on both direct and EAD routes scores 5.

countries.aip_authority: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA Kuwait)
countries.notes: Kuwait DGCA publishes AIP and supplements as text-based vector PDFs (confirmed from binary analysis: fonts/Tj present, no DCTDecode/scan markers). Portal at dgca.gov.kw/AIP; supplements in Azure blob CDN at dgcawebappstg.blob.core.windows.net. Main AIP procedure charts (AD2 SID/STAR) available but portal was returning 503 at verification time — supplementary PDFs are openly accessible. No eAIP HTML, no AIXM. AIRAC-aligned. Score 6 for open vector PDFs; no registration required for supplements.

countries.aip_authority: Republic of Marshall Islands Directorate of Civil Aviation (RMIDCA) / FAA (procedure publisher)
countries.notes: No national AIP published by RMI. FAA publishes instrument procedures for PKMJ and PKWA in the Pacific d-TPP (open PDF) and NASR CIFP (open ARINC-424) under Compact of Free Association authority. CIFP is open download, no account. Confidence medium: FAA notes records may be incomplete for non-US facilities.

countries.aip_authority: MOLDATSA / Moldavian Air Traffic Services Authority
countries.notes: MOLDATSA publishes EUROCONTROL-format eAIP HTML; portal at aim.moldatsa.md requires registration/login. Also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration, AIXM 5.1). ECAC state; AIRAC-compliant. Historical eAIP HTML confirmed at rossiya-airlines mirror (2016 vintage). Moldova chose apsXML for eAIP production. EAD Basic provides AIXM 5.1 lookup. Score 5 due to mandatory free-account for direct national portal and EAD route.

countries.aip_authority: UCAA / SMATSA llc (Serbia and Montenegro Air Traffic Services)
countries.notes: Montenegro eAIP is published jointly with Serbia by SMATSA at smatsa.rs. Web portal is openly accessible without login; current cycle (Jun 2026) confirmed live. Standard EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML with AD-2 sections for Montenegro airports (LYTV Tivat, LYPG Podgorica). PDF procedure charts embedded within eAIP. ECAC/EAD member; EAD Basic also provides AIXM 5.1. Irregular joint-state structure adds minor friction; score 4.

countries.aip_authority: Eastern Caribbean Civil Aviation Authority (ECCAA) / Trinidad and Tobago CAA (TTCAA) AIS
countries.notes: Saint Vincent procedures are in the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP published by TTCAA Piarco AIS. Subscription required (USD 100/yr for non-state entities; free for state CAAs under mutual exchange). eAIP updated only 3x/year; format is downloadable PDF. No open HTML eAIP and no AIXM data.

countries.aip_authority: Albcontrol / Air Navigation Services of Albania
countries.notes: Albcontrol publishes openly accessible EUROCONTROL eAIP HTML at albcontrol.al/aip. Multiple 2025 AIRAC cycles confirmed (Jan, Mar, Aug, Nov 2025). SID/STAR charts explicitly listed in GEN-3.2 chart catalogue. Obstacle data also available in AIXM 5.1 format. ECAC/EAD member; EAD Basic AIXM 5.1 provides additional lookup. Irregular eAIP structure with chart PDFs for procedures; score 4.

countries.aip_authority: ARMATS CJSC (Armenian Air Traffic Services), Civil Aviation Committee
countries.notes: ARMATS publishes an eAIP in HTML format (EUROCONTROL eAIP spec, frameset structure) updated per AIRAC cycle (current 01-26 effective 19 FEB 2026). Direct section URLs publicly resolve but return a Cloudflare verification screen, suggesting free-account or anti-bot gate. An 'eAIP Subscription Order Form' exists on the site. Armenia is an ECAC state; EAD Basic (free registration) also serves as backup ground truth for significant points. No AIXM export. Score 5 for eAIP behind a free-account / verification gate.

countries.aip_authority: Eastern Caribbean Civil Aviation Authority (ECCAA) / Trinidad and Tobago CAA (TTCAA) AIS
countries.notes: British Virgin Islands procedures are covered under the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP produced by TTCAA Piarco AIS. Same subscription model as Saint Vincent (USD 100/yr or state-exchange). No independent BVI eAIP; gov.vg civil aviation page does not host procedure data. PDF format only.

countries.aip_authority: BCAA / Burundi Civil Aviation Authority (Autorite de l'Aviation Civile du Burundi)
countries.notes: BCAA website (aacb.gov.bi) has AIP Supplement and AIM Publication sections but no publicly accessible eAIP or downloadable procedure charts confirmed. Embry-Riddle Electronic AIP guide listed Burundi as 'not available' (as of 2020). HBBA airport has SID/STAR/IAP procedures per Navigraph/third-party sources, but the national authority does not publish them openly online. AIP likely paper-primary with limited digital distribution on request. Not an EAD/ECAC state. Score 9 (restricted/very limited digital access, no open eAIP confirmed); confidence low as direct access could not be verified.

countries.aip_authority: ASECNA (Agence pour la Securite de la Navigation Aerienne en Afrique et a Madagascar)
countries.notes: Equatorial Guinea is an ASECNA member state; all procedures published within the single multi-country ASECNA eAIP at aim.asecna.aero. eAIP HTML for aerodrome data (GEN, ENR, AD sections) openly accessible. Instrument procedures (SID, STAR, IAC) published as separate PDF charts in the eAIP atlas (aim.asecna.aero/html/eAIP/cartes/atlas/). ASECNA uses AIXM 4.5 database internally. Charts are French-language vector PDFs. No registration found needed. Score 6 for PDF-chart-only procedures with French-only text and multi-country portal navigation.

countries.aip_authority: FSM Division of Civil Aviation (DCA) / FAA (procedure publisher)
countries.notes: FAA IFIM notes no national AIP published by FSM. FAA publishes procedures for PTPN (Pohnpei), PTYA (Yap), PTKK (Chuuk) in Pacific d-TPP and NASR CIFP (open ARINC-424). FAA Airport/Facility Directory PAC volume covers FSM. Confidence medium: FAA notes non-US records may be incomplete.

countries.aip_authority: Samoa MWTI Civil Aviation Division / Aeropath NZ (publisher)
countries.notes: AIP authority is the Director of Civil Aviation under Samoa Ministry of Works, Transport & Infrastructure (MWTI); Aeropath NZ distributes. Free PDF download ($0 NZD) but requires account/checkout. No eAIP HTML or coded data. Charts are vector PDF. +1 for portal friction.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Agency of Tajikistan (published by CAICA Russia)
countries.notes: AIP published by Russia's CAICA on behalf of Tajikistan Civil Aviation Agency. HTML index wrapper at caica.ru/aiptjk with individual PDF sections. UTDD (Dushanbe) AD2 PDF confirmed text-based (fonts/Tj present, no scan markers, 1.9 MB). Updated per AIRAC (19 FEB 26 effective date confirmed). No AIXM. SID procedures exist (SID PF 1A/1B referenced in NOTAM). +1 for third-party Russian portal hosting and indirect navigation.

countries.aip_authority: FAA / AeroNav Services
countries.notes: American Samoa's only instrument-procedure airport is Pago Pago Intl (NSTU, ICAO prefix NS). FAA publishes procedures in NASR CIFP (open ARINC 424) and Pacific d-TPP. Freely downloadable without registration. NSTU has published IAPs and departure procedures current to each AIRAC cycle. Score 2: open coded ARINC 424.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Affairs / Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications
countries.notes: Open eAIP HTML at aim.mtt.gov.bh (no registration, free). HTML aerodrome pages embed RNAV GNSS approach waypoint tables (path terminators, coordinates, altitudes in HTML). SID/STAR conventional charts are vector PDF links in the eAIP. No AIXM. Hybrid HTML-table plus PDF-chart structure; reasonably parseable but irregular across procedure types.

countries.aip_authority: DC-ANSP (Dutch Caribbean Air Navigation Service Provider)
countries.notes: DC-ANSP publishes a free open eAIP for all six Dutch Caribbean islands including Bonaire (TNCB). eAIP is HTML with AIRAC-cycle amendments; SID/STAR procedural descriptions appear in aerodrome sections as text but detailed charts are PDF links. Full PDF version also available for download. No AIXM data published.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Authority of the Cayman Islands (CAACI) / Cayman Islands Airports Authority (CIAA)
countries.notes: AIP (GEN, ENR, AD sections) freely downloadable as PDF from caymanairports.com, no account required. Covers MWCR (Owen Roberts Intl) and MWCB (Charles Kirkconnell). Instrument approach charts, SIDs and STARs included in AD section as vector PDF. Published in English. No AIXM or coded data.

countries.aip_authority: ANACM (Agence Nationale de l'Aviation Civile et de la Meteorologie) / ASECNA
countries.notes: Comoros is an ASECNA member state. ASECNA publishes eAIP HTML at aim.asecna.aero covering FMCH (Moroni/Prince Said Ibrahim) with SID/STAR/IAP charts as PDF. ASECNA AIMANT database is AIXM 4.5. eAIP HTML pages appear publicly accessible; full digital dataset (AIXM 4.5 export) requires subscription (approx 100 EUR/yr). French-language primary. Confidence medium due to uncertain open-access boundary.

countries.aip_authority: Civil Aviation Department (CAD) — Hong Kong SAR
countries.notes: Hong Kong AIS at ais.gov.hk publishes eAIP in HTML (no registration required). VHHH AD-2 HTML contains structured tables: waypoint coordinates, SID/STAR name-to-runway assignments, climb gradient requirements, and some altitude crossing constraints. However, detailed procedure geometry (leg-by-leg sequences, turn directions, speed restrictions on intermediate legs, RF leg radii) are only in linked PDF charts (e.g. VH-AD-2-VHHH-SID-RAMEN-C.pdf). Waypoint coordinates for shared fixes must be cross-referenced against EAD or ICAO APAC database. No AIXM output. Mixed HTML-table + PDF structure; HTML is parseable but incomplete without PDF charts. Score 4: open eAIP HTML with parseable but irregular/mixed structure requiring PDF supplement.

countries.aip_authority: KANS (Kosovo Air Navigation Services Agency) / Civil Aviation Authority of Kosovo
countries.notes: Open eAIP published by KANS at kans-ks.org (formerly ashna-ks.org; 301 redirect active). HTML eAIP shell with SID/STAR procedures as PDF chart files. Approach procedure charts appear to be vector PDFs. Direct fetch returns 403 for deep HTML pages; PDF charts accessible. Kosovo is not a full ECAC EAD participant; no confirmed AIXM export. Portal fragility and PDF-chart-only procedures add friction.

countries.aip_authority: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA Lebanon), Ministry of Public Works and Transport
countries.notes: Lebanon DGCA AIP distributed via beirutairport.gov.lb/zip (returns 403) and OLBA airport portal (olba.aero/AIP.php — requires form fill). Third-party archived PDFs (IVAO Lebanon, 2021 vintage) confirm text-based vector PDFs with SID/STAR/IAP charts. Procedure data appears significantly out of date in public domain (most recent verified AIP: 25 MAR 2021). Infrastructure fragility from 2020 Beirut port explosion era. Ongoing airport works and political instability reduce reliability. +1 for access friction (form fill) and stale public copies. Confidence low due to portal inaccessibility at verification time and currency uncertainty.

countries.aip_authority: AIM Belgium (skeyes) / ANA Luxembourg
countries.notes: Luxembourg AIP is jointly published with Belgium by AIM Belgium/skeyes at ops.skeyes.be (confirmed ELLX AD-2 pages present). eAIP is public/free; skeyes direct HTML pages return 403 from outside EU but eAIP is otherwise open. ECAC state: full EUROCONTROL EAD coverage with AIXM 5.1 export (free registration). EAD is the authoritative machine-readable source. Score 5 reflects EAD free-account path.

countries.aip_authority: M-NAV / Civil Aviation Agency of North Macedonia
countries.notes: Open eAIP at ais.m-nav.info (no registration required). Frameset-based HTML portal; most procedure sections link to PDF files rather than embedding HTML tables. ECAC state: data also available via EUROCONTROL EAD Basic (free registration, AIXM 5.1). No direct AIXM download from national portal. EAD is the preferred machine-readable source (score reflects EAD free-account path).

countries.aip_authority: FAA / AeroNav Services
countries.notes: Northern Mariana Islands airports (PGSN Saipan, PGRO Rota, PGWT Tinian) are covered in FAA NASR CIFP (open ARINC 424, free download, no account). d-TPP PDF charts also freely available. CIFP updated every 28 days. No AIXM output; procedures fully coded in ARINC 424-18. Score 2: open coded ARINC 424 ground truth.

countries.aip_authority: QCAA / Qatar AIM
countries.notes: Open eAIP HTML at aim.gov.qa (no registration). SID/STAR and IAP procedures delivered exclusively as PDF charts per aerodrome AD-2.24 index. Tabular procedure PDFs are vector (Adobe Distiller/PostScript); graphical approach charts are scanned/image PDFs (OCR needed). No AIXM data. Mixed vector+scan PDF corpus with per-chart portal navigation adds friction (+1).

countries.aip_authority: FAA / AeroNav Services
countries.notes: US Minor Outlying Islands: airports span multiple ICAO prefixes — Palmyra Atoll (PLPA, prefix PL), Wake Island (PWAK, prefix PW), Midway (PMDY, prefix PM), Johnston Atoll (PJON, prefix PJ). Instrument procedures for active fields (PWAK has RNAV/VOR/DME approaches; PLPA has instrument approaches) are in FAA NASR CIFP and d-TPP, both freely downloadable. Many islands have no published instrument procedures or closed airfields. Confidence medium due to sparse/military-restricted access at some fields. Score 2 where procedures exist (open ARINC 424 CIFP).

countries.aip_authority: ONDA / SIA Maroc (Morocco)
countries.notes: Western Sahara is administered by Morocco; airports GMMH (Dakhla) and GMML (Laayoune) appear in the Morocco ONDA/SIA AIP. The SIA Maroc site serves a mix of HTML pages and per-aerodrome PDF documents (e.g. AD2GMMH.pdf); direct PDF URLs return 403, and an annual subscription/renewal system is in place (Abonnement 2026). No AIXM or coded data. Site uses the GM prefix for all Moroccan territory including the Western Sahara FIR Casablanca. eAIP HTML menus resolve to 403. Effectively a paid-subscription PDF AIP with poor open access; +1 for clunky portal and subscription friction.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (publisher); ECCAA (safety oversight, HQ in Antigua)
countries.notes: Antigua and Barbuda procedures are published in the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP produced by TTCAA/Piarco AIS. ECCAA headquarters is in Antigua (St John's) and provides regional safety oversight, but it does not publish the AIP. Same paid-subscription, login-gated, PDF-format model as other Eastern Caribbean states. ICAO AERODROME: TAPA (VC Bird Intl, St John's). No AIXM, no open access.

countries.aip_authority: Barbados Civil Aviation Authority (BCAA) / Air Navigation Services Dept
countries.notes: Barbados publishes its own independent AIP via BCAA (successor to the Civil Aviation Department); it is NOT included in the TTCAA Eastern Caribbean AIP state list. The Barbados AIP is available from the Aeronautical Information Service at BB$100/copy + BB$80/yr amendment service — sold by contact, no public online portal or eAIP found. Format is PDF (or possibly still physical/CD), no AIXM. BCAA website (bcaa.gov.bb) does not expose a public AIP download. Confidence medium because no current online portal was directly verified; ICAO AERODROME: TBPB (Sir Grantley Adams Intl). Jeppesen/Navigraph chart data is the practical alternative for procedures.

countries.aip_authority: Department of Civil Aviation (DCA) Brunei Darussalam
countries.notes: DCA publishes AIP as PDF amendment pages at dca.gov.bn (no eAIP HTML portal; document list page confirms all-PDF format). Aerodrome charts (e.g. WBSB AD 2-1, AD 2-22) are scanned image PDFs requiring OCR. Text-based supplements (GEN, ENR sections) are vector PDFs. No AIXM. Only one instrument airport (WBSB). Open access, no registration; but scanned chart format and no structured HTML eAIP make extraction difficult.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (publisher); ECCAA (safety oversight)
countries.notes: Dominica procedures are published in the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP produced by TTCAA/Piarco AIS, which covers Anguilla, Antigua & Barbuda, BVI, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, St Kitts/Nevis, St Lucia, St Vincent & the Grenadines, and Trinidad & Tobago. Access is via paid subscription (wire transfer, no online payment); free only for State CAA bodies with a Piarco AIS exchange agreement. The portal is login-gated. Format is electronic PDF download, not structured eAIP HTML; updated 3x/year (not AIRAC-aligned). No AIXM, no open download. Shared publisher across all ECAC Eastern Caribbean states except Barbados.

countries.aip_authority: Falkland Islands Civil Aviation Department (civilian AIP) + UK MOD No.1 AIDU (EGYP military)
countries.notes: Split AIP: civilian Falkland Islands AIP (GEN/ENR/AD for SFAL Stanley) published freely at falklands.gov.fk as PDF; EGYP (RAF Mount Pleasant) procedures in UK MOD AIDU raster PDF at aidu.mod.uk/aip/pdf/ad/EGYP-Mount-Pleasant-Combined.pdf. SIDs exist at EGYP per ENR data. EGYP PDF confirmed raster/image-based. No eAIP HTML; no AIXM. Not ECAC. Score 8: scanned PDF (military), split civilian/military sources, no coded procedures. Confidence medium: SFAL civilian procedures completeness not fully verified.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (Eastern Caribbean AIP, E/CAR)
countries.notes: Grenada (TGPY Maurice Bishop International) is included in the Eastern Caribbean AIP (E/CAR) published by TTCAA Piarco AIS. TGPY has published RNAV (GNSS) approaches for RWY 10 and RWY 28; NDB approach withdrawn after NDB GND decommissioned. The E/CAR eAIP is available free of charge only to State civil aviation bodies under reciprocal agreement; all other subscribers receive a proforma invoice (paid annual subscription). The AIP is updated only 3 times per year (not AIRAC-aligned). Format is PDF-text; no HTML eAIP or AIXM published. ECCAA oversees regional safety but TTCAA publishes AIP. Score 9: paid access, PDF-only, non-AIRAC update cycle, and formal request process required.

countries.aip_authority: FAA / AeroNav Services
countries.notes: Guam (PGUM Antonio B. Won Pat Intl) is a US territory; all SID/STAR/IAP procedures are in FAA NASR CIFP (open ARINC 424) and d-TPP PDFs. Both freely downloadable without account from aeronav.faa.gov. CIFP is the authoritative ground truth for coordinate lookup. Score 2: open coded ARINC 424.

countries.aip_authority: NATS (National Air Traffic Services) / UK AIS — Guernsey Civil Aviation Authority
countries.notes: Guernsey (EGJB) is a UK Crown Dependency whose AIS is an integral part of the UK AIS system, published by NATS under the EG ICAO prefix (EGJ-block). The UK eAIP at aurora.nats.co.uk is freely accessible to the public without registration for the HTML AIP product. EGJB AD 2 section is present with full aerodrome data; SIDs (GULDA, ORTAC, DINARD, CAEN, SKERY) and STARs are published within the UK AIP structure. Charts are published as PDFs linked from the eAIP. No AIXM output. Score 4: open eAIP HTML with standard UK irregular structure requiring multi-cycle URL tracking.

countries.aip_authority: Transport Malta / Civil Aviation Directorate (MATS)
countries.notes: Malta is an ECAC/EAD member state. eAIP conversion (EUROCONTROL-compliant) was completed ~2010 via Managed-AIS. Current AIP served as downloadable PDF sections from transport.gov.mt and maltats.com (5th Edition, AIRAC-aligned). No publicly navigable HTML eAIP portal confirmed; procedure charts are vector PDF. EAD Basic carries Malta data (AIXM). Single IFR airport: LMML (Luqa). Score 6: open vector PDF with portal navigation needed.

countries.aip_authority: Department of Civil Aviation, Republic of Mauritius
countries.notes: Open eAIP HTML hosted on govmu.org, no registration required. Covers FIMP (Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Intl) and FIMR (Plaine Corail). Procedure charts linked as PDF from the HTML structure. RNAV/RNP1 SIDs and STARs implemented. No AIXM output. Irregular URL versioning per AIRAC cycle requires path-tracking. Score 4: open eAIP HTML, irregular structure.

countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC France (Direction de la Navigation Aérienne)
countries.notes: Réunion (FMEE Roland Garros, FMEP Pierrefonds) is French territory; AIP published under SIA France as the RUN supplement. The SIA eAIP viewer (htmlshow) requires login/account creation ('Me connecter'). However, static PDF versions of procedure sections are served directly from sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr paths for those who know the URL. The libre-disposition eAIP ZIP download covers metro France primarily; RUN is included in the broader eAIP set but accessed via the account-gated viewer in practice. Score 5: eAIP HTML behind free registration, matching the EAD-tier access pattern.

countries.country: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
countries.aip_authority: ASSI (Air Safety Support International) / ATNS (Air Traffic and Navigation Services, South Africa) as service provider
countries.notes: Saint Helena Airport (FHSH/HLE) procedures are published by ASSI (UK CAA subsidiary for Overseas Territories) with ATNS (South Africa) as the AIS service provider and hosting entity. AIP is distributed as PDF documents from atns.com under a 'St Helena Projects' section. Charts are vector PDF with selectable text (confirmed: embedded fonts Arial/Calibri, not scanned). Instrument procedures include RNP approach RWY 01, SIDs and STARs. No eAIP HTML, no AIXM, no coded data. Score 7: vector PDF charts requiring portal navigation; ATNS site navigation to find the correct section adds friction; last confirmed amendment 2025.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (publisher); ECCAA (safety oversight)
countries.notes: Saint Kitts and Nevis (St Christopher/Nevis) procedures are published in the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP produced by TTCAA/Piarco AIS. Same shared-publisher model as Dominica: paid subscription, login-gated portal, PDF download format, updated 3x/year, no AIXM, no open access. ECCAA provides safety oversight. ICAO AERODROMES: TKPK (Robert L Bradshaw Intl, Basseterre) and TKPN (Charlestown/Nevis).

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (publisher); ECCAA (safety oversight)
countries.notes: Saint Lucia procedures are published in the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP produced by TTCAA/Piarco AIS. Same shared-publisher model as Dominica and Saint Kitts: paid subscription, login-gated portal, PDF download, updated 3x/year, no AIXM, no open access. ECCAA provides safety oversight. ICAO AERODROMES: TLPC (George FL Charles/Vigie, Castries) and TLPL (Hewanorra Intl, Vieux Fort).

countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC France (CAR-SAM-NAM region)
countries.notes: Saint Pierre et Miquelon airports LFVP and LFVM published in SIA eAIP CAR-SAM-NAM, freely accessible without registration. LFVP has ILS CAT I/II/III (RWY 26) plus RNAV; LFVM has NDB and RNP approaches. HTML + PDF charts. Procedure tables are parseable but the SIA eAIP has irregular structure across sections; no AIXM coded data published. URL pattern: sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_<DATE>/CAR-SAM-NAM/. ICAO prefix LF applies because PM is administered as a French collectivity using the metropolitan LF prefix (LFVP, LFVM).

countries.aip_authority: INAC (Instituto Nacional de Aviação Civil de São Tomé e Príncipe)
countries.notes: São Tomé and Príncipe (FPST São Tomé Intl, FPPR Príncipe) has INAC as its civil aviation authority. No public eAIP or AIS portal is visible on inac.st. ASECNA covers 18 member states but São Tomé is not an ASECNA member and is not published on aim.asecna.aero. The only accessible procedure data is via Jeppesen/Navigraph (paid subscription). A national AIP GEN document exists in archived form (docplayer) but procedures/charts are not digitally published to an open portal. Score 9: effectively restricted/only available via commercial chart vendors; no public AIP portal found. Confidence low — a national AIP may exist in paper or internally but is not verifiable online.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA (Trinidad and Tobago Civil Aviation Authority) / Piarco AIS
countries.notes: Trinidad and Tobago is the publisher of the Eastern Caribbean (E/CAR) AIP and its own procedures are contained within that publication. TTCAA/Piarco AIS is the AIP authority for the entire region. The eAIP portal at caa.gov.tt is login-gated (returns 403 without credentials). Format is PDF download, not structured HTML; updated 3x/year (not AIRAC-aligned). Paid subscription for external users; free exchange for State CAA bodies. No AIXM, no open coded database. ICAO AERODROMES: TTPP (Piarco Intl, Port of Spain), TTCP (Crown Point Intl, Tobago).

countries.aip_authority: FAA / AeroNav Services
countries.notes: US Virgin Islands airports (TIST Cyril E. King, TISX Henry E. Rohlsen) are covered in FAA NASR CIFP and Southeast d-TPP volume. All procedures freely downloadable. d-TPP explicitly covers Virgin Islands. CIFP is open ARINC 424 ground truth. Score 2: open coded ARINC 424.

countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC France (PAC-N region)
countries.notes: Wallis and Futuna published in SIA eAIP PAC-N. NLWW (Hihifo/Wallis Island) has RNP RWY 08 and RNP RWY 26 instrument approaches; NLWF (Futuna Pointe Vele) is VFR-only with no published IFR procedures. HTML + PDF format, freely accessible without registration. No AIXM coded data. URL pattern: sia.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/media/dvd/eAIP_<DATE>/PAC-N/. SIA eAIP irregular structure adds parsing friction (+1 from base 3 for open eAIP HTML). Only NLWW has scoreable IFR procedures.

countries.aip_authority: TTCAA / Piarco AIS (Eastern Caribbean AIP, produced for Anguilla on behalf of UK)

countries.aip_authority: Bermuda Airport Authority (BAA) — Department of Airport Operations, L.F. Wade International
countries.notes: Bermuda (TXKF) publishes a full eAIP at airportauthority.bm, openly accessible without registration. HTML eAIP sections available per AIRAC cycle (e.g. TX-AD-2.TXKF). Score 7 for PDF-chart-only procedures behind portal navigation, despite open access.

countries.aip_authority: US DoD / UK MoD joint military facility (Diego Garcia NSF); no civil AIP authority
countries.notes: Diego Garcia (FJDG) is a US Navy/UK joint military base with no public civil AIP. ASSI (UK Air Safety Support International) has advisory responsibility only. No public eAIP exists; procedures are available only through US DoD/military channels or via commercial chart providers (Jeppesen, Navigraph) sourced from US military publications — not publicly downloadable. Effectively inaccessible for automated AIP parsing. Score 10 for paper/military-only with no public digital AIP.

countries.aip_authority: DC-ANSP (Dutch Caribbean Air Navigation Service Provider)
countries.notes: Same DC-ANSP shared eAIP as Aruba; covers Curacao (TNCC/Hato). Charts are image-PDF (MicroStation .dgn rendered via Distiller) — OCR needed for data extraction. countries.aip_authority: SIA / DGAC France (RUN region, Iles Eparses)
countries.notes: French Southern and Antarctic Lands (TAAF) has only military/research airstrips: Europa Island (no ICAO code), Tromelin (TF-0001, no public ICAO), Juan de Nova (FMZJ), Glorioso Islands, plus heliports at Kerguelen and Amsterdam Island. countries.aip_authority: Gibraltar Civil Aviation Authority (GEN/ENR) + UK MOD No.1 AIDU (AD/procedures)
